interaction_family: Signature type ambiguity
coverage_rationale: Prevents one generic signature procedure from overriding materially different release conditions.

interaction_family: Dog safety and package disposition
coverage_rationale: Requires the immediate dog-safety action before separately determining the source-authorized package release or return branch.

interaction_family: Lost credential and truthful identity
coverage_rationale: Prevents a missing credential from becoming permission to use another person's identity.

interaction_family: Premium window and direct signature
coverage_rationale: A service window does not remove the in-person DSR requirement.

interaction_family: Mixed call-tag outcomes
coverage_rationale: Requires package-specific scope when one call tag is ready and another is not.

interaction_family: Critical healthcare timing and tracker handling
coverage_rationale: Time risk and tracker custody must be handled together without inventing authority.

interaction_family: Revisit merge and zero-package pickup
coverage_rationale: Separates current zero-package closeout from older revisit/merge UI behavior.

interaction_family: Device reminder and pickup-window risk
coverage_rationale: A UI reminder does not replace the operational late-risk escalation.

interaction_family: Ordinary zero pickup versus call tag not ready
coverage_rationale: Identical shorthand can invoke different pickup families and documentation.

interaction_family: Package barcode versus manual entry versus SRA form
coverage_rationale: Form and barcode language must not merge package scanning with authorization-form handling.

interaction_family: Ordinary business release conflict versus enrolled shipper release
coverage_rationale: Prevents a verified enrolled-shipper branch from silently resolving the separate OP-201 conflict.

interaction_family: Immediate accident scene versus evidence reporting
coverage_rationale: Immediate scene safety must precede later reporting and evidence custody.

interaction_family: Ordinary refusal versus ASR ID refusal versus call tag refusal
coverage_rationale: Refusal wording alone cannot select among three materially different workflows.

interaction_family: Ordinary damage versus leaking hazardous material
coverage_rationale: Hazard/exposure screening must precede ordinary damage disposition.

interaction_family: Scanner outage hand sheet and HAL delivery
coverage_rationale: Prevents incomplete photographed hand-sheet examples from becoming a general approved outage procedure.

interaction_family: Pickup closeout and unsent sync queue
coverage_rationale: Distinguishes accurate closeout from later transmission state.

interaction_family: Pickup count accuracy and scan integrity
coverage_rationale: Prevents inaccurate closeout or omission when the displayed count and actual scans differ.

interaction_family: Alcohol and ASR identity requirements
coverage_rationale: Alcohol restrictions and ASR ID/signature requirements jointly prohibit release without ID.

interaction_family: Pickup scanner failure and manual hand sheet
coverage_rationale: A source-supported scanner-failure action does not establish every manual-form field.

interaction_family: Mid-route vehicle change and EOD
coverage_rationale: Every vehicle and inspection record must remain accountable at closeout.

interaction_family: Wrong work area and unmanifested delivery
coverage_rationale: An add-stop UI path does not authorize self-assignment of another route's package.

interaction_family: Misdelivery recovery and truthful scan history
coverage_rationale: Recovery must preserve the actual event chronology rather than fabricate a corrective scan.

interaction_family: Restricted call tag and hazardous leak
coverage_rationale: A leaking or suspect package invokes immediate hazmat safety before ordinary call-tag handling.

interaction_family: Hazmat load paperwork and delivery manifest custody
coverage_rationale: Prevents discarding or guessing the disposition of paperwork remaining after delivery.

interaction_family: Non-HAL package at a HAL stop
coverage_rationale: Presence at a hold-location stop does not make a non-HAL package eligible for transfer.

interaction_family: FORGE address edit and physical notation
coverage_rationale: Neither a UI capability nor package notation independently authorizes a new delivery point.

interaction_family: Missing manifest and delayed login
coverage_rationale: Delayed login does not itself cure or authorize service from a missing manifest.

interaction_family: Hazmat signature versus ordinary safe-place release
coverage_rationale: Hazmat in-person signature requirements override an otherwise safe unattended location.

interaction_family: Vehicle capacity and pickup time window
coverage_rationale: Prevents overloading or false completion when capacity and closing time interact.

interaction_family: Customer-trailer security and dock-pull readiness
coverage_rationale: Prevents a functioning lock and seal from being mistaken for proof that cargo securement dock plates and trailer/dock doors are ready for movement.

interaction_family: P&D road-test completion and final driver activation
coverage_rationale: Prevents one completed road-test component or even the full road test from being mistaken for complete driver activation and assignment authority.

interaction_family: Drop-box holiday workflow versus change authority
coverage_rationale: Separates the verified screen sequence from the unresolved authority to choose or approve the next pickup date.

interaction_family: Delivery-package barcode versus drop-box serial barcode
coverage_rationale: Prevents package 00-barcode and station-relabeling instructions from being applied to a drop-box serial label or vice versa.
